answer.headline: Senior data scientist with nine years in energy and weather analytics, focused on production demand forecasting, statistics and experiments

experiences.title: Senior Data Scientist
experiences.summary: Owns hourly electricity demand forecasts for 400,000 customers in production, cutting day-ahead error from 7.9% to 5.1% MAPE. Designed A/B tests of tariff messages, writes the team's analytical SQL and presents forecast uncertainty to traders and management.

evidence.quote: Own the hourly electricity demand forecasts for 400,000 customers, in production since 2021, using gradient boosting and SARIMA models in Python.
Cut the day-ahead forecast error from 7.9% to 5.1% MAPE.
Designed A/B tests of tariff messages to customers, with pre-registered metrics and CUPED variance reduction.
Write most of our analytical SQL in PostgreSQL and BigQuery, including window functions over three years of meter readings.
Explain forecast uncertainty to the trading desk and to management in a monthly forecast review.

experiences.title: Analyst
experiences.summary: Statistical analysis of weather station data in R and Python, and a Bayesian model of wind power output in Stan.
